# Streamplace

The stream.place player and its chat. Nothing to register: this site is its own app there.

Choose it during setup on the **Modules** page; its setup page then appears with the steps below. The same steps are in the Admin Panel later.

The addresses below are for a site at `example.com`; your setup page shows your own.

## 1. Your stream.place account

Paste your handle, as in you.bsky.social, without the @. When you save, the site finds your account's DID (did:plc:…) from it. There is no app to register: stream.place reads this site's own sign-in description at the first address below, and sends people back to the second. Check finds the account and fetches that description.

Links:

- [stream.place](https://stream.place/)

Copy into the provider's page:

| What | Value |
|---|---|
| Client id (nothing to paste anywhere) | `https://example.com/oauth/client-metadata.json` |
| Redirect URL | `https://example.com/api/auth/link/streamplace/callback` |

This step fills:

- **Streamplace handle**. The handle the Streamplace player opens.
